Saved browser has no submitted metadata request, response, preview/apply error or exact DOM field readback; runtime root cause is not captured.

Refresh checks dirty/frozen state only before awaiting fetch. On response it unconditionally installs state without request generation or active target validation. Mode change force-refreshes, leaving previous request pending. Preview selects field from mode but target/document/revision from state. A delayed prior-mode response can therefore overwrite the selected target or filled policy after correct metadata selection. Frozen apply preserves whichever request was previewed, including a wrong/stale selection. This is a concrete source race; occurrence in saved failure is not proven.

Preview must require matching mode/path/record; keep frozen mutation exact.
